answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the relic queue naming the juniper that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 3 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, each extra identity burns 3 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the signal record exposes exactly who is still on probation. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
